overall_validity.rationale: All specified variables and rules are instantiated directly and consistently through detailed CRM-based interactions, steady but moderate lead inflow, high yet realistic customer responsiveness, and a balanced emphasis on both commercial progress and relationship quality. The assistant’s behavior tightly matches its role, authority, and constraint specifications (balanced relational/transactional goals, proactive but non-pushy outreach, neutral professional tone, and moderate contact cadence). World updates, resource updates, and actor behaviors are applied once per round with coherent continuity across rounds, and consequences are framed in terms of both engagement and movement toward demos, trials, and quotes, aligning with the balanced rewards setting. The rendering avoids meta-references and variable labels, instead manifesting all factors through concrete emails, scheduling, and follow-up patterns.
